title: Differential brief schema (engage-apothecary path subagent output)
description: Output shape of each parallel differential subagent. Mandatory: diagnosis, mechanism, ≥1 evidence-tier-weighted citation, testCharacteristics, contraindicationReasoning. Optional web-research metadata: webResearch flag, webResearchSuspect flag (set by the primary agent's subagent-fabrication check).

mechanism.description: Mechanistic / pathophysiologic reasoning, ≤150 words (≤1500 chars approximate).

testCharacteristics.description: Sensitivity / specificity / likelihood ratios where well-published; qualitative ranking otherwise. Explicit 'data not well-published' is valid; fabricated quantitative LRs are not.

contraindicationReasoning.description: What would argue against this diagnosis given the scenario.

webResearch.description: True if WebFetch/WebSearch was used for citations; false when --no-web was set (tier capped at expert-opinion).

webResearchSuspect.description: Set by the primary agent's subagent-fabrication check when citations were returned without recorded attemptedCalls.

attemptedCalls.description: Record of WebFetch / WebSearch invocations the subagent claims to have made. Empty when --no-web.
